Definition InterpF : FreeCat S ⟶ P := Build_Functor (FreeCat S) P (@prop_of_nat P) (fun m n t => interp P S v t) (fun m n s t Hst => interp_sound P S v Hst) InterpF_fmap_id (fun m n p f g => InterpF_fmap_comp f g)  (* existence half: any valuation of the generators in a PROP P extends to a functor out of the free PROP; InterpF_Symmetric upgrades it to strict symmetric monoidal *)

Definition FreePROP : PROP := {| prop_cat := FreeCat S; prop_strict := FreeCat_Strict S; prop_symmetric := FreeCat_Symmetric S; prop_monoidal_coherence := eq_refl; prop_of_nat := fun n : nat => n; prop_unit_zero := eq_refl; prop_tensor_plus := fun m n => eq_refl |}
